grammar.title: Expected to with 预计
grammar.pattern: 预计 + 主语 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 预计 (yùjì) means "to estimate, to expect" — used before a prediction about the future, like a schedule, weather, or result. It usually starts the sentence.

sentences.pinyin: Yùjì zhège gōngzuò yào sān tiān.
sentences.en: This job is expected to take three days.

sentences.pinyin: Yùjì huì yǒu yī qiān rén cānjiā.
sentences.en: About a thousand people are expected to attend.
